title: The Association With Peptic Ulcer Disease and Hepatic Vein Pressure Gradient
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to assess the role of portal hypertension of peptic ulcer disease in liver cirrhosis and chronic hepatitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The patients who underwent hepatic vein pressure gradient (HVPG) measurement and esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) and also had LC or chronic hepatitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* The patients who have missing or incomplete HVPG or EGD data
* The patients who underwent gastrectomy
* The patients who have systemic malignancy
study_population: Investigators will analyze the medical records of hepatic vein pressure gradient (HVPG) and esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD) cases who had LC or chronic hepatitis in single tertiary hospital of Korea.
